Who We Are
 Worldline helps businesses of all shapes and sizes to accelerate their growth journey - quickly, simply, and securely. We are the innovators at the heart of the payments technology industry, shaping how the world pays and gets paid. Our technology powers the growth of millions of businesses across 5 continents. And just as we help our customers accelerate their business, we are committed to helping our people accelerate their careers. Together, we shape the evolution.
 The opportunity
 At Worldline, our technology addresses persistent challenges of the payment world. Worldline is the European leader in digital payments and #4 worldwide. We’ve established ourselves as a leading developer of creative software solutions for enabling the cashless society.
 Day-to-day Responsibilities
Develop new modules or services to improve Worldline’s velocity and innovation
Integrate and promote development best practices and guidelines in our environment that can be followed by NRE teams
Develop, configure and enhance our automation stack and our CI/CD pipelines.
Integrate unitary tests in your CI/CD piplelines in order to improve efficiency and velocity in core releases
Collaborate and share with all our stakeholders in the organization.
Support NRE members to put in production the code using automation and CI/CD
Manage, innovate, and create Shared services and tooling that continuously improve the availability, scalability, and efficiency of Worldline
Work cross-functionally to build fast, reliable, and resilient production coding
Create Documentation that every NRE member can use, improve and share. Technical documentation and user documentation.
Secure our coding, obviously in the payment industry security is must and should be taken into account from the very beginning
 Who Are We Looking For
Minimum of 5 years of python coding in production environments
Having a knowledge in Network protocols and standards (TCP/IP, BGP, VPN, DNS, Firewall, Load-Balancer)
Expert in Python programming using advanced frameworks (Flask, Django)
Experienced in API programming to align with our “API first” strategy and web development (HTML, CSS, JS…)
Expertise in AI for coding usage to leverage AI to produce coherent and reusable code (NRE module catalog)
Experience with Linux ( Red Hat / CentOS ) and source version control like Git, GitLab, , GIT flows and CICD
Used to work with Terraform (we aim that all pieces of infra is defined with code)
Knowledge of cloud solutions and mindset (AWS, GCP, Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform) and security standards (PCI-DSS,...)
Excellent communication skills in English
 Perks & Benefits
 In addition to joining a global leader in payments, you can also expect an excellent range of benefits. These include a rewarding salary, leave days, an attractive pension scheme, global learning days and many more. We also have location specific benefits, varying from private medical insurance, to extended parental leave and a flexible benefits scheme, allowing you to purchase discounted products and services.

Free private medical services
21 vacation days/year
Referral bonuses for new hires recommended by you
WFH & Flexible Working Hours
Full access to the “Learning” platform
